response.rationale: A and B describe almost the same capability: "Skating session scheduling and capacity management" versus "... capacity planning". The only difference is the last word, which doesn't change the meaning. They also overlap in the code. Community:1 contains RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1) and SessionRepository (node e3915d8f30e495a9). Component:business contains RinkService, the same node. RinkService is the domain service that runs the logic, and SessionRepository is the persistence layer it uses for sessions. That means A and B are two views of one session scheduling and capacity capability, not two separate ones. Confidence is less than full because community:1 also includes repositories for other areas, such as bookings, hire stock, temperature and payments. That makes its scope wider than the label on A.
